title: The Lantern Road
summary: Word of what you are has spread. The villages along the old road want to light it end to end, the way it was before the cult, and they want you to carry the first flame. Place twenty lanterns along the road out of your village.

goals.say: The road glows all the way to the hills. Travellers walk it at night again.

quest_book.title: Light the Road
quest_book.author: The Villages of the Old Road
pages:
We've talked it over, all of us, from the river to the hills.

We want the old road lit again.
We want you to light the first lantern. You know why.

threats.name: Village Elder
threats.target_line: Look at it. The whole road, lit. You did that.
talk: Then nobody walks it alone any more. That's your doing.
